title: Initmate Flamenco Night
text: Intimate atmosphere....very enjoyable but would be great to have learnt more about Flamenco / the story before the show started
author: Jon_G

title: An unforgettable flamenco experience in Seville
text: Absolutely excellent show! The dancers were amazing and you could really see how much passion and heart they put into every performance. The guitar players were incredibly talented, and the singers were absolutely fantastic. The whole show was full of energy, emotion and pure talent. I thoroughly enjoyed every minute and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Seville. A truly wonderful experience!
author: Steve_W

title: Flamenco Show in Seville
text: Booked the day before and was worth every penny. Small theatre, you can order a drink that’s brought to your table. Amazing show, the dancing and music were brilliant.
author: Journey24490882497

title: Best flamenco!
text: Our group had a wonderful time at this flamenco show! They are clearly very professional and care deeply about their art. This is definitely the only flamenco tablao I'll visit when coming to Spain!
author: tman4lom

title: Tradition
text: A real flamenco dance and music experience. We all loved it and definitely recommend to others..  loved the emotion.
author: Steven_C

title: The best so far
text: Fantastic! The benchmark for any other flamenco performance. Fourth time over many years, never disappointed.
author: jjstraw

title: Flamenco at its best!
text: An authentic flamenco performance from singers, dancers and guitarists.  Excellent show and well worth seeing.  Great atmosphere in the tablao which was cozy with small round tables and subdued lighting.  Also a selection of complimentary drinks offered. Great way to spend an evening and enjoy Flamenco at it's best!
author: Adventurer696174

title: Unreal authentic show...
text: Unreal authentic show would recommend if you come to Sevilla. The artist are amazing its a unforgettable experience
author: Lorena_B

title: Incredible flamenco
text:
The fee was 38€ each for the hours show. To be honest I would have paid double. The artists were amazing and the performance incredible. One of the best performances I have seen. Thank you so much. 
Bea, one of the staff members, was very helpful. 
Altogether a very enjoyable visit.
author: Deborahhaywood

title: Passionate!
text: I highly recommend this venue for flamenco, it’s authentic, beautiful, and moving . Extraordinary,  I loved it!
author: Deborah_A
